title: North Carolina owner wins appeal over city's immunity defence in 361-home flooding dispute
summary_full: A North Carolina property owner has won a significant legal victory against the City of Concord in her lawsuit. This case involves stormwater flooding allegedly caused by a nearby residential development, leading to property damage. The North Carolina Court of Appeals ruled that the city cannot claim governmental immunity at this stage. The decision allows the property owner to continue her claims of negligence, trespass, and nuisance.
